test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: Metals are good conductors of heat.
Lead and mercury are best conductors of heat.
Pure metals have a shining surface

solution:
The correct answer is __**Lead and mercury are the best conductors of heat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Silver and copper** is the best conductor of both electricity and heat.
 
• Both are good conductors of heat
